title: Nunchi-Bench: Benchmarking Language Models on Cultural Reasoning with a Focus on Korean Superstition

model.params_source: paper Appendix B (greedy decoding, temperature = 0, top-p = 0); max_tokens assumed

items.source: koreankiwi99/Nunchi-Bench, file nunchi_mcq.csv (columns ID, culture, kor_contents, eng_contents, eng_question, kor_question, eng_choices, kor_choices, label); mirror github.com/koreankiwi99/Nunchi-Bench

output.postprocess: strip, uppercase; refusals or non-English/Korean replies counted as incorrect (Sec. 3.2)
output.parse_paper: letter (A-D): first standalone capital letter A-D in the reply; fallback: option text match

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 31 English MCQs answered with the labelled option
metric.original_location: Appendix E, Table 15, row GPT-4o, column English MCQ (30 of 31; Korean 93.5)

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare --dry-run 2026-09-07 (chars/4 input tokens, max_tokens counted as output per call)

notes: If the API rejects top_p = 0, use top_p = 0.01 (greedy is already fixed by temperature 0).
